title: 按住講
mood: cheeky, rambling and very pleased with himself
subject: a retired grandfather who has just discovered hold-to-talk voice messages and sends seven-minute ones to the family group chat, which everyone answers with a sticker in three seconds
caption: Temple Street cabaret Cantopop, the working-class 1970s-80s Hong Kong nightclub and street-stall lounge sound. An Electone-style electric organ with rotary vibrato playing off-beat cha-cha chord stabs; a honky-tonk upright piano rolling under the verses; a live cha-cha drum kit with rimshot, cowbell and guiro on the off-beats; a walking electric bass; an alto saxophone answering every vocal phrase, and a single brass hit on each punchline. Roomy but dry, like a small live band in a dance hall, organ and voice forward, saxophone panned right. Older male voice, gravelly and nasal with Cantonese opera training and a wide vibrato, talk-singing the verses with spoken asides, a few backing singers shouting 'hey!' where the lyrics have it, then a belted chorus. 112 BPM, C major. A retired grandfather cheekily proud of his seven-minute voice messages. No hip-hop beat, no rap flow, no EDM, no autotune, no modern pop ballad.
lyrics:
[Verse]
個孫教我㩒個綠色嘅咪
手指㩒實佢 就可以講嘢
唔使打字 唔使搵老花鏡
今朝我一㩒 㩒足七分鐘

[Pre-Chorus]
講完天氣 講街市豬肉又貴咗
講埋隔籬屋隻狗 吠到我瞓唔著 嘿！

[Chorus]
按住講 按住講 阿叔我有排講
手指一鬆 就斷咗 唔緊要 再嚟過
成個家族群組 淨係得我把聲
你哋有冇聽到尾 我唔理

[Verse]
新抱三秒就覆我一個公仔
七分鐘嘅嘢 三秒點聽得晒
個孫話 阿爺 你可以打字㗎
我話打字 係後生仔玩嘅嘢

[Pre-Chorus]
講完馬經 講聽日去邊度飲茶
講埋五十年前 點樣識你阿嫲 嘿！

[Chorus]
按住講 按住講 阿叔我有排講
手指一鬆 就斷咗 唔緊要 再嚟過
成個家族群組 一條條都係我把聲
你哋三秒覆個公仔 我知㗎

[Bridge]
喂 喂 聽唔聽到呀 呢個咪係咪壞咗
個孫話佢哋聽 一律開兩倍速
我講嘢已經夠快 再快 成何體統

[Chorus]
按住講 按住講 阿叔我有排講
手指一鬆 就斷咗 唔緊要 再嚟過
成個家族群組 一條條都係我把聲
開到兩倍速 阿叔變咗米奇老鼠

[Outro]
阿嫲喺廚房大叫 食飯喇
等陣 等我按住 講埋呢句先
